# hermes-lcm v1.0.0-rc.2

Lossless Context Management for Hermes Agent. This release candidate rolls up the post-RC1 fixes on the maintained `wzgrx/hermes-lcm` main branch.

## Highlights

- Make automatic foreground compaction bounded by shared pass and time ceilings, including ingest and sanitation preparation; leave manual/forced maintenance behavior intact.
- Prevent redundant summary work on tiny or non-compressing chunks, enforce L1/L2/L3 token budgets, and avoid repeated no-progress preflights when a shorter fallback route cannot meet its threshold.
- Keep SQLite WAL and sidecar identity tied to each live store; detect replacement or corruption at bind/use time and fail closed rather than continuing with a misleading healthy state.
- Reconcile post-compaction rebind/replay against persisted rows so follow-ups survive without duplicating stored fresh-tail content.
- Mark generated summaries and proactive recall as hidden transcript context while preserving genuine user/assistant turns.

## Changes

- Adapt and test the upstream storage-containment and replay fixes (upstream PRs #630 and #633), plus generated-context classification (upstream #635).
- Honor the host journal-mode policy, retry bounded startup lock contention, and bound session-end SQLite waits.
- Clear only the outgoing conversation's automatic carry on explicit `/new`; preserve historical messages and summary nodes for search.
- Keep the host-rejection backoff effective during automatic preflight while still allowing emergency recovery and deterministic sanitation.
- Avoid whole-transcript re-ingest after active-tail mutation and keep `lcm_compile_evidence` compatible with providers that reject top-level JSON-Schema combinators.
- Preserve the 15 public LCM tool schemas and declared lifecycle hooks.

## Upgrade and rollback

This is a prerelease candidate. Before changing the live plugin, run `/lcm backup`; for a filesystem backup, stop every SQLite writer and copy `lcm.db` together with its WAL/SHM companions as one quiescent snapshot. Update to this tag, restart Hermes, send one ordinary message, then check `lcm_status` (`plugin_version: 1.0.0-rc.2`) and `/lcm doctor` (SQLite `quick_check`, WAL, schema `5`). There is no manual core migration or embedding backfill. Optional extraction, query-view, pre-answer evidence, embeddings, and adaptive retrieval remain opt-in. Restore the pre-upgrade backup before rolling back to RC1.

See [the operator guide](https://github.com/wzgrx/hermes-lcm/blob/v1.0.0-rc.2/docs/operator-guide.md#upgrade-from-v100-rc1-to-v100-rc2) and [the full changelog](https://github.com/wzgrx/hermes-lcm/blob/v1.0.0-rc.2/CHANGELOG.md) for detail.
